    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">DB升级 23.26.2：/opt 空间临界导致 OPatch 失败的处理记录</span>
    

</a>
</h2>
    <small>
<span id="post-date" data-last-update-days="0" data-date-updated="2026-07-24 22:37">2026-07-24 22:37</span>&nbsp;
<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jyzhao">AlfredZhao</a>&nbsp;
阅读(<span id="post_view_count">43</span>)&nbsp;
评论(<span id="post_comment_count">0</span>)&nbsp;
&nbsp;
<a href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="AddToWz(21894824);return false;">收藏</a>&nbsp;
<a href="https://report.cnblogs.com?targetLink=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cnblogs.com%2Fjyzhao%2Fp%2F21894824&amp;targetId=21894824&amp;targetType=0" target="_blank">举报</a>
</small>
    <div class="entry">
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>这次尝试升级到 23.26.2 时，笔者又遇到了一个很典型的问题：<code>/opt</code> 空间看起来差不多够，但 OPatch 实际执行时仍然容易失败。记录一下处理过程，方便后续遇到类似情况时快速判断。</p>
<h2 id="01--问题出在刚好够的-opt-空间">01 | 问题出在“刚好够”的 /opt 空间</h2>
<p>当时 <code>/opt</code> 的精确可用空间是：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">13652123648 bytes
</code></pre>
<p>也就是大约 <code>13.65 GB</code>。而 OPatch 检查到需要：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">12787.7 MB
</code></pre>
<p>从数字上看，好像还有一点余量，但这类场景并不稳。OPatch 在实际 <code>apply</code> 时，还需要额外空间用于解压、备份、rollback 和临时文件，所以“检查时看着差不多，真正执行时失败”很常见。</p>
<p>当时查看 <code>/opt</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[root@aibs ~]# df -Th /opt
Filesystem Type Size Used Avail Use% Mounted on
/dev/mapper/VolGroupVm-LogVolOpt ext4 25G 11G 13G 46% /opt
</code></pre>
<p>这里的关键不是只看 <code>Avail</code> 是否大于 OPatch 提示值，而是要给补丁过程留出实际操作空间。</p>
<h2 id="02--扩容后重新检查并继续打补丁">02 | 扩容后重新检查并继续打补丁</h2>
<p>笔者给 <code>/opt</code> 增加了 <code>5G</code> 空间：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">lvextend -L +5G /dev/VolGroupVm/LogVolOpt
resize2fs /dev/VolGroupVm/LogVolOpt
</code></pre>
<p>扩容后再次查看：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[oracle@aibs ~]$ df -h /opt
Filesystem Size Used Avail Use% Mounted on
/dev/mapper/VolGroupVm-LogVolOpt 30G 11G 18G 38% /opt
</code></pre>
<p>随后重新执行 OPatch 空间检查：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">$ORACLE_HOME/OPatch/opatch prereq CheckSystemSpace \
-phBaseDir /u01/media/39093711
</code></pre>
<p>检查通过后继续安装补丁，结果成功：</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">Patch 39093711 successfully applied.
Sub-set patch [38743669] has become inactive due to the application of a super-set patch [39093711].
Please refer to Doc ID 2161861.1 for any possible further required actions.
Log file location: /opt/oracle/product/26ai/dbhome_1/cfgtoollogs/opatch/opatch2026-07-17_10-31-55AM_1.log

OPatch succeeded.
</code></pre>
<p>接下来按照 readme 打开数据库，包含所有 PDB，并继续执行 <code>datapatch</code> 等必做步骤。</p>
<p><code>datapatch</code> 执行完成后，可以看到补丁在各个容器中都应用成功：</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">Patch 39093711 apply (pdb CDB$ROOT): SUCCESS
Patch 39093711 apply (pdb PDB$SEED): SUCCESS
Patch 39093711 apply (pdb DATACLAWPDB): SUCCESS
SQL Patching tool complete on Fri Jul 17 10:45:21 2026
</code></pre>
<p>之后编译无效对象：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">$ORACLE_HOME/perl/bin/perl $ORACLE_HOME/rdbms/admin/catcon.pl -n 1 -e -b utlrp -d $ORACLE_HOME/rdbms/admin utlrp.sql
</code></pre>
<p>最后登录确认版本和 PDB 状态：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SQL*Plus: Release 23.26.2.0.0 - Production on Fri Jul 17 10:48:08 2026
Version 23.26.2.0.0

Connected to:
Oracle AI Database 26ai Enterprise Edition Release 23.26.2.0.0 - Production
Version 23.26.2.0.0

SQL&gt; show pdbs;

 CON_ID CON_NAME OPEN MODE RESTRICTED
---------- ------------------------------ ---------- ----------
 2 PDB$SEED READ ONLY NO
 3 DATACLAWPDB READ WRITE NO
</code></pre>
<p>这次问题的核心很简单：OPatch 提示的空间需求不是最终唯一标准，实际 apply 过程还需要额外余量。对于接近临界值的 <code>/opt</code>，先扩容再打补丁，处理过程会更稳。</p>
<p>关注我，和AI一起成长~</p>
